existing_v1_diagnosis.metadata_denominator: Acceptance-criteria task terms were compared against declaration/path metadata despite body-level candidate retrieval.
existing_v1_diagnosis.mixed_score_ratio: Fixed bonuses and saturating FTS transforms make raw composite score ratios uncalibrated confidence.

proposed_v2.status: Agent design proposal; final code/constant freeze separate.
proposed_v2.query_evidence: Project-local FTS document frequencies and bounded verified candidate-code frequencies; informative metadata and code-like channels required, or explicit anchor. No global probability/completeness claim.
proposed_v2.ambiguity: Compare independent candidates informative evidence sets rather than raw BM25/composite score ratio.
proposed_v2.delivery: Existing complete-file secure preparer and bounded resolved helper bundle.
proposed_v2.utility_scope: Lexical evidence heuristic, not semantic usefulness, confidence calibration or completeness proof.
proposed_v2.lexical_parser: Reuse pinned Tree-sitter JavaScript/TypeScript/TSX grammars in a trusted isolated worker; retain Python tokenizer with explicit ERRORTOKEN rejection.
proposed_v2.implementation_status: Final scoped implementation reviewed; formal freeze is coordinator responsibility.
native_parser_boundaries: fixed application-script import path, never indexed root/cwd/env search paths
has_error or missing syntax declines whole evidence operation
include worker time and disclose parent CPU excludes child work

review_conditions: Explicitly bound count/bytes/SQL/lexical work; abstain when required candidate comparisons are incomplete.
Apply current approval, ignore, safe-path, symlink, sensitive-source and size checks to every evidence body.
Compare current hashes with indexing versions and recheck policy/source versions for all decision-affecting bodies, not just delivered winners.
Generic lexing must not be described as proof of executable semantics; handle opaque syntax conservatively and test comments/strings/regex/templates.
Version the policy receipt, preserve V1 reproduction, validate diagnostics strictly.
Keep whole selected code faithful; no silent dependency-body truncation.
Include full refresh, body reads and all abstention overhead in task time.
Keep memory injection disabled and no selection model calls.

pricing_verification.threshold_scope: Per model request full input; more than threshold reprices full request. Aggregate native-turn input not one request.
unknowns: server-confirmed service tier and endpoint classification

preconditions: retain failures, fallbacks, interruptions and unrun assignments

initial_patch_findings.mechanism: Regex unmatched block-comment alternative retries scanning the remaining body at later comment starts; incomplete quoted strings/templates/comment syntax also leaks literal/comment terms into code-like evidence.

observed_defect_probe.kind: Small read-only helper reproduction on synthetic source, not a product benchmark or held-out task
observed_defect_probe.timing_scope: single wall-time calls including first import effects; shared host, no statistical uncertainty estimate; used to identify scaling defect, not claim product latency
lexical_cases: closed comment and quoted string exclude invoice/subtotal
unclosed block comment, quote and template included invoice/subtotal as code-like terms

initial_patch_findings.requested_fix: Linear finite-state scanning with conservative incomplete syntax handling and regression controls. Agent notified; no application edit by reviewer.
initial_patch_findings.resolution_status: Resolved: custom backtracking lexer removed entirely, pinned syntax worker and explicit Python tokenizer errors reviewed; original negative evidence retained.

nonblocking_design_notes: Sufficient evidence currently uses informative metadata/code union with any code match; clarify whether rare-term agreement must include informative_code rather than any common code term.
Generic code-like scanner remains lexical evidence, especially for regex/JSX/templates; do not imply runtime execution or semantic completeness.
Additional evidence hash passes and full refresh can add overhead even on SKIP.

followup_findings.mechanism: Python3.11 tokenizes unclosed single-quoted contents after ERRORTOKEN rather than raising TokenError. Filtering only NAME tokens can count literal contents; host3.12 TokenError behavior does not validate this case.
followup_findings.requested_fix: Explicitly reject ERRORTOKEN and regression-test supported behavior.
followup_findings.resolution: Python token stream explicitly rejects nonwhitespace ERRORTOKEN; simulated supported-version control passes.

followup_findings.mechanism: Regex literal after if-closing parenthesis or typeof is treated as ordinary slash/code and yields pattern words; common assignment regex context is opaque correctly.
followup_findings.requested_fix: Conservative opaque-context handling or accurately bounded code-like lexical claim with regression cases.
followup_findings.resolution: Custom JS-family lexer removed; isolated pinned grammar classifies regex/template/JSX syntax, validated with independent examples.

reviewer_reproduction_after_linear_fix.kind: Small synthetic read-only helper controls, not product benchmark or held-out tasks

formal_interpretation_notes: B is an author-known-path baseline; human target discovery time is outside measured preparation and cannot be claimed saved.
If B/C deliver identical prompts, automatic C adds local preparation work; native outcome variation alone is not evidence of better source selection.
Path-free usability and benefit over bare A are distinct from cost superiority over oracle-path B; classify identical-prompt controls and abstentions transparently.
